decisions.reason: As a newly launched product tightly linked to the firm’s established airfield systems business and strategic move toward integrated intelligent airport operations, it is likely to be retained because there is no visible performance shortfall yet and the firm’s R&D-based capabilities provide enough slack to continue learning.

This surveillance display also fits the firm’s core airport-operations portfolio, and under bounded rationality management would usually keep such a recent product on the market unless early results clearly fell below aspirations, which is not indicated here.
